title: A1 mutation adequacy on real code, the rerun of I61's catalog with I61's defects fixed
plan: docs/BUILD_PLAN.md#i22 (kill criterion, threshold and exit, as I61); I61's rule for a defect in its tools (tests_m2/test_mutation_adequacy_i61.py, Rules): a rerun of every mutant from scratch, the first run reported

predictions.claim: Baseline. The null mutant, re-extracted from scratch and projected, decides M0 exactly as results/M0 does (L_par_hdr_v0, L_par_hdr_v1, L_rt_go_v0, L_rt_go_v1, L_rt_go_v2 PROVED; L_par_hdr_v2, L_par_hdr_ssvh, L_dom_hdr REFUTED), M1x as results/M2/differential.json 'extracted' (7 PROVED, 7 REFUTED, L_tag_BVH UNKNOWN) and M2 as results/M2 (6 PROVED, 4 UNKNOWN, 2 REFUTED); its documents, projection, law statuses, own inputs and flags are I61's baseline's, and its i20_step corpus file is byte-identical to I61's (the deployment probe of D2 changes nothing on the original code).

Totals and M2 exit (b). Stratum A: 96 of 192 killed (79 with a K1 law), 12 equivalent, 0 in error, rate_non_equivalent 96/180 = 0.533 < 0.80 (exit (b) not met), its non-error rates equal to the plain ones (I61: 7 errors). Stratum B: 0 of 50 killed, 5 equivalent, 0 in error.

Nothing but the fixes moves: every catalog record equals I61's in outcome, class, kill (laws and how), obstruction lists, flags and per-law baseline, mutant status, how, witness and prediction, except the fixes' effects: D1 on A001 and A058, D2 on A076, A098, A100, A101 and A104, D3 and D4 on A027, A031, A116 and A120.

D1. A001's L_rt_go_v0, L_rt_go_v1, L_rt_go_v2 and A058's L_rt_go_v1 satisfy K1 (each witness I61's recorded one, every hit replaying on the mutant and none on the original), so A001 is killed by five laws and A058 by two; no record has a replay disagreement; the extraction defects are I61's 19 less A001 (18).

D2. A076, A098, A100, A101 and A104 complete their i20_step run with every trace's deployment reverted (steps 0, no new disagreement, all 3013 baseline corpus steps differing), are corpus_detected with no extraction defect, and survive, filed rule_gap (law_unmoved); A076 keeps its masked obstruction on L_dom_hdr. corpus_detected is I61's 82 mutants plus these five (87).

D3 and D4. The two SORT-width laws of A027, A031, A116 and A120 are decided UNKNOWN by a run with no error; A116 and A120 survive, filed rule_gap (law_unmoved); A027 and A031 stay killed; no record holds an error.

The harness gate passes at its first attempt: on the original code the harness reproduces I16's outputs of all six edges, agrees with the baseline model wherever the model is defined, falsifies no PROVED M0 law and replays every REFUTED M0 law's witness; C1 and C2 are killed by K1 through L_par_hdr_v0, C3 by K1 through L_par_hdr_v1, L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2 (I61: L_par_hdr_v1 only, the other two replay disagreements), C4 by K2 with partiality witnesses through L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2; no control has a replay disagreement or a replay error.

Rates. Per operator, family, language and site, stratum A's counts are I61's with every error count 0, and the PAR-round-trip family kills 56 mutants (I61: 54; A001 and A058 join it); the structural agreement is I61's with the 7 former errors filed rule_gap/law_unmoved; the unpredicted, recomputed-only, masked and proof-lost lists and the K1-only, plan-literal, new-law, model-tie, detection, dedup, B-codec and contradiction rates are I61's.
D6. No record, control record or gate detail holds a duration, an absolute path of the run's machine or a Python traceback frame.

regressions.claim: Gates M0, M1 and M2 pass at the iteration's last commit. I62 changes no law, statement, facts document, extracted document or record status outside its outcome paths: the M1 and M2 records differ from the parent's only in generator_sha256 (holon/records.py is in the generator closure, D3) and timings; the gate's regenerated results/M2/metrics.json changes only its mutation_adequacy entry (I62's summary); I62 never writes to the pinned checkout, sol_deps or spec/M2/disagreements.json, and leaves the extractors, the M0 pipeline, holon differential, holon derive, holon fragments and the I16, I20 and I15 harnesses unchanged (D2 runs copies).

Construction: the frozen instrument is I61's but for the fields the defects touch (the 242 mutants, the controls, the scope, the predicted sets, the structural classes and the diff sheet byte for byte); every I61 construction check holds for it (threshold and its consequence, seed, counts, controls outside the catalog, in-scope bytes, operator rewrites, the sheet's rendering, pins, tce); holon.mutate.operators enumerates exactly the 242 mutants; apply checks the original text; holon/mutate names nothing of the target; mutate sheet --check reproduces the sheet; run --dry-run refuses every missing or failing precondition and accepts a complete set.

regressions.claim: Exit (BUILD_PLAN I22, M2 exit (b), Q6): rate_non_equivalent of stratum A >= 0.80, recomputed by test. I62-P2 and the instrument's threshold.consequence forecast that it fails; it stays as the exit check.

Whitepaper §13 metric 'mutation adequacy' and §12.1 'Sensitivity': results/M2/metrics.json reports mutation_adequacy {source results/M2/mutation_i62/summary.json, threshold 0.8, rate_all, rate_non_equivalent, meets_threshold} of stratum A, superseding I61's source.

I61's run stays as written and is reported as the first run: its key unchanged, its records, summary, gate, report, review, adjudication and panel record unchanged since this prereg; its tests read I61's files through HOLON_MUTATE_KEY=I61 by two amendment lines (run_holon, the metrics test), nothing skipped; holon/mutate serves both keys, I62 by default.
